INSERT INTO inbox_story_citations (id, candidate_id, inbox_item_id, inbox_revision_id, position, locator, revision_sha256) VALUES (#{id}, #{candidateId}, #{source.inboxItemId}, #{source.inboxRevisionId}, #{position}, #{locator}, #{revisionSha256})
mapper.sql: candidate.id, candidate.reference, candidate.workspace_id, candidate.extraction_id, candidate.title, candidate.problem, candidate.role, candidate.goal, candidate.value, candidate.cognitive_mode, candidate.content_sha256, candidate.proposed_at, decision.id AS decision_id, decision.action AS decision_action, iteration.id AS selected_iteration_id, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inbox_story_citations citation JOIN inbox_items item ON item.id = citation.inbox_item_id WHERE citation.candidate_id = candidate.id AND item.latest_revision_id <> citation.inbox_revision_id ) AS stale
mapper.select: SELECT FROM inbox_story_candidates candidate LEFT JOIN inbox_candidate_decisions decision ON decision.candidate_id = candidate.id LEFT JOIN iterations iteration ON iteration.source_candidate_id = candidate.id WHERE candidate.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND candidate.id = #{candidateId}

SELECT citation.id, citation.candidate_id, citation.inbox_item_id, citation.inbox_revision_id, citation.position, revision.revision_number, citation.revision_sha256, citation.locator FROM inbox_story_citations citation JOIN inbox_revisions revision ON revision.id = citation.inbox_revision_id WHERE citation.candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY citation.position ASC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iterations WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND lane = 'discovery' AND lifecycle IN ('provisioning', 'active', 'provisioning_failed')

mapper.select: SELECT iteration.id, iteration.reference, iteration.workspace_id, iteration.source_candidate_id, iteration.source_candidate_sha256, iteration.lifecycle, iteration.loop, iteration.stage, iteration.lane, iteration.version, iteration.base_commit_sha, iteration.branch_name, iteration.provisioning_failure_summary, story.id AS active_story_id, iteration.admitted_by_user_id, iteration.admitted_at, iteration.updated_at FROM iterations iteration LEFT JOIN stories story ON story.iteration_id = iteration.id WHERE iteration.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND iteration.id = #{iterationId}
